 1037|     public override async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
 1038|     {
 1039|         try
 1040|         {
 1041|             await Close(connectionClosing: false, async: true, isDisposing: true).ConfigureAwait(false);
 1042|         }
 1043|         catch (Exception ex)
 1044|         {
 1045|             // In the case of a PostgresException (or multiple ones, if we have error barriers), the reader's state has already been set
 1046|             // to Disposed in Close above; in multiplexing, we also unbind the connector (with its reader), and at that point it can be used
 1047|             // by other consumers. Therefore, we only set the state to Disposed if the exception *wasn't* a PostgresException.
 1048|             if (!(ex is PostgresException ||
 1049|                   ex is NpgsqlException { InnerException: AggregateException aggregateException } &&
 1050|                   AllPostgresExceptions(aggregateException.InnerExceptions)))
 1051|             {
 1052|                 State = ReaderState.Disposed;
 1053|             }
 1054|             throw;
 1055|         }
 1056|         finally
 1057|         {
 1058|             Command.TraceCommandStop();
 1059|         }
 1060|     }
